product.title: Neuro Dry+ Folding Professional Dual-Voltage Hair Dryer
product.description: Experience fast, frizz-free blowouts anywhere with the Paul Mitchell Neuro Dry+ Folding Professional Dual-Voltage Hair Dryer. This compact and lightweight dryer features a powerful digital motor for speedy styling, and its unique design automatically pauses airflow when the handle is released, ensuring energy efficiency. With three heat and speed settings, a cool shot button, and automatic dual voltage for worldwide use, this dryer offers personalized styling. It also includes a memory function to recall your last settings and a long 9-foot cord for convenience. The dryer comes with three magnetic attachments (nozzle, diffuser, and pik), a storage bag, a cleaning brush, and a two-year warranty.
